content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.openai.throttled", "docchat.ingestion.throttled") | summarize throttled = sum(Sum) by deployment = tostring(Properties["deployment"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
content.title: 429s by deployment, chat path and ingestion

content.query: let calls = AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.openai.duration" | summarize calls = sum(ItemCount) by deployment = tostring(Properties["deployment"]); let thr = AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.openai.throttled" | summarize throttled = sum(Sum) by deployment = tostring(Properties["deployment"]); calls | join kind=leftouter thr on deployment | extend throttledPct = round(100.0 * coalesce(throttled, 0.0) / calls, 2) | project deployment, calls, throttledPct
content.title: Throttled share of chat-path calls

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.chat.generate", "docchat.chat.rewrite", "docchat.chat.search_passage", "docchat.chat.followups", "docchat.chat.embed", "docchat.summary.rebuild", "docchat.memory.extract") | summarize p50 = percentile(DurationMs, 50), p95 = percentile(DurationMs, 95), calls = sum(ItemCount) by Name, deployment = tostring(Properties["docchat.deployment"])
content.title: Model-call latency p50 and p95 by call

content.query: AppDependencies | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.chat.generate" | extend firstChunk = todouble(Properties["docchat.first_chunk_ms"]) | where isnotnull(firstChunk) | summarize p95 = percentile(firstChunk, 95), calls = count() by deployment = tostring(Properties["docchat.deployment"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
content.title: First-chunk latency p95 per deployment

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.openai.duration" and tostring(Properties["outcome"]) == "ok" | summarize meanMs = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxMs = max(Max), calls = sum(ItemCount) by deployment = tostring(Properties["deployment"]), call = tostring(Properties["call"])
content.title: Mean duration of successful calls by deployment and call

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.openai.tokens", "docchat.ingestion.tokens") | summarize tokens = sum(Sum) by deployment = tostring(Properties["deployment"]), kind = tostring(Properties["kind"]), bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
content.title: Tokens by deployment and kind

content.query: union (AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("docchat.chat.screening.flagged_sources", "docchat.chat.screening.failures") | summarize n = sum(Sum) by item = Name), (AppEvents | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name in ("content_filter_triggered", "content_filter_degraded", "source_screening_flagged") | summarize n = todouble(count()) by item = Name)
content.title: Screening and filters

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} and Name == "docchat.ingestion.stage.duration" and tostring(Properties["stage"]) in ("enrich", "embed") | summarize meanS = sum(Sum) / sum(ItemCount), maxS = max(Max) by stage = tostring(Properties["stage"]), methodKey = tostring(Properties["method_key"])
content.title: Ingestion enrich and embed stage time
